acceptanceCriteria: Receipts from the Corvint Playwright reporter and RSpec formatter carry a titlePath array; a non-literal title yields a present titlePath in test-validity output, covered by a test.
body: Residual from V1-2045 (PR #1319, LPCV-V0-145..149). Test-validity locations take titlePath from committed source because receipts keep only joined names, so titlePath is absent for non-literal titles (internal/testvaliditydoc/location.go). Expected: the Corvint Playwright reporter and RSpec formatter record titlePath as an array in receipts, and the location projection prefers it.
title: Playwright reporter and RSpec formatter should emit a structured titlePath array
